entities.name: Susurians
entities.description: A race of massive vampires from the Lip of Susur who command gravitational threads, founders of Monoism, still part of the Monasteriat.

entities.name: Lip of Susur
entities.description: Photon collar ringing Point Prime in the Edge, from which the Susurians emerged.

entities.name: Point Prime
entities.description: Formerly the Susur star, now the first and most holy supervoid of Monoism.

entities.name: Monoism
entities.description: Faith whose first tenets the Susurians divined.

entities.name: Monasteriat
entities.description: Body of the Monoist faith of which Susurians are part.

entities.name: Astelli
entities.description: Species the Monoists consider twin to the Susurians.

events.summary: The Susurians emerged from the Lip of Susur when the Susur star was reduced to a gravitationally torn carcass.
events.quote: They emerged from the Lip of Susur when the Susur star was reduced to a gravitationally torn carcass.

relations.quote: The Susurians divined the first tenets of Monoism and founded the faith.
They are still part of the Monasteriat.
